scope: Technical microcomparison and correctness controls; not resource workload improvement or human A/B
changedFactor: Retained-history scanning versus unresolved per-view or global indexes
task: Same board views, delivery targets, ordered patch/version/nonce/chat/snapshot/late-HTTP/recovery events and observation timestamps
acceptance: Same full retained delivery map, target pending sets, sequence/canonical merged state, normal/slow latency order and values, no double count, unchanged scheduling/guards/checkpoint grading
negativeControls: Missing/stale target remains pending; completed historical record cannot be read by reflect
stoppingCondition: Meaningful red then equivalence/control green, existing selfchecks, typecheck, fresh independent review reconciled
excluded: No server, browser, full300s workload, provider actions, commits or push

microcomparison.timingLimit: One deterministic local technical diagnostic; no resource-workload or host-general speed claim
